title: Fed Decision Oct 28 and Alphabet Q3 Earnings: Markets Brace for Super Week
summary: The FOMC meets Oct 27–28; the rate decision is Wednesday Oct 28 at 2 pm ET. Per CNBC (Oct 25), fed funds futures suggest ~90% odds of holding rates at 3.75%–4.00%, though Bank of America calls a 25bp hike. Alphabet Q3 2026 results are due after close the same day. ECB also meets Thursday.
why: 本周双重催化剂：美联储决议（概率来源：CNBC Oct 25 fed funds futures）与Alphabet Q3财报同日触发，是全年密度最高的组合。结果直接影响持仓折现率与AI相关标的估值，Sell Put 隐含波动率将放大。沃什(Warsh)主席措辞偏鹰则科技仓位承压。

title: 恒生科技指数失守3900点，年内累计跌幅超30%再创年内新低
summary: 10月22日，港股大跌，恒生科技指数跌破3900点，年内累计跌幅超30%，再创年内新低。腾讯控股、阿里巴巴轮番下挫为主要拖累，科网股、AI硬件板块全线承压。
why: 港股科技板块整体受压，持仓腾讯、阿里巴巴均受直接冲击。年内跌幅超30%意味着指数仍未止跌，Sell Put 期权须审视下行保护是否充足，尤其关注行权价与当前价差安全垫。

title: Meta Q3 2026: Revenue +26% to $64.6B, Board Approves 2-for-1 Split via New Class C Shares
summary: Meta Q3 2026 revenue was $64.6B, up 26% YoY. Family of Apps ad revenue rose 26%; ad impressions +10%, avg price per ad +14%. GAAP operating income fell 37% due to a $9.9B legal charge. Board approved new non-voting Class C common stock as a 2-for-1 split effective Jan 2027. Stock rose ~3% after hours.
why: Meta不在持仓，但作为大盘科技代表：强劲AI广告营收印证数字广告需求健康，对谷歌（GOOGL）广告业务前景有正面信号；股票拆分提升流动性，AI资本支出虽高但商业化能力强，对AI板块情绪整体正面。

title: Nvidia's AI Financier Role Faces First Big Test as Neocloud Partners Take Market Hit
summary: CNBC reports rising scrutiny of Nvidia's evolving role as both chip supplier and financial backer of neocloud operators, providing minimum revenue guarantees and equity stakes. Bond yields on neocloud companies have risen sharply and share prices have fallen, raising questions about Nvidia's off-balance-sheet credit exposure.
why: 英伟达（NVDA）持仓核心风险：若市场对AI资本支出周期信心动摇，NVDA估值承压且Sell Put 隐含波动率两面失守。同时波及SK海力士（HBM需求预期）。
